description: This source file defines the class AdoNetRemindersProviderBuilder, which implements the IProviderBuilder interface for ISiloBuilder. It configures the AdoNet reminder service for Orleans silos by reading configuration settings and setting up database connection parameters.

classes.name: AdoNetRemindersProviderBuilder
